items.text: Students will use 5 target words (name, age, family, like, school) in descriptive sentences.

resources: Flashcards of the 5 target words with simple icons

note.title: Teacher note - gestures
note.body: Point to yourself for name, hold up fingers for age, hug your arms for family, thumbs up for like, make a roof over your head for school.

sections.greeting: Good morning, class! Today we learn some powerful new words.

stories.label: A short story
stories.text: A little girl named Pinky went to a big building to read and write. Where was she? At school!
Zainab lives with her mother, father and baby brother. What do we call them? Family!

wordWall.meaning: how many years old you are
the place where you go to learn

steps.label: Teacher Model
steps.body: I like to paint nice pictures. Who? I. Action? like. Description? to paint nice pictures.

steps.label: Shared Practice
steps.body: Bilal goes to a big school. Who? Bilal. Action? goes to. Description? a big school.

cfu.q: Which word means the people you live with?
"I am six years old." Which word is this?
In the formula, what comes after Who/What?

sections.task: All students write original sentences for all 5 target words using Who/What + Action + Description.
sections.note: Work in pairs (brainstorming) or individually (focused writing) based on your class.

samples.text: My school has a big park.

differentiation.advanced: Use two target words in one sentence: "My family likes my school."

afl.instruction: Thumbs up if the target word is used correctly, thumbs down if wrong.

items.text: I eat my name for breakfast.
My family lives in my house.
I sleep in my school at night.

sections.exitTicket: Have 2-3 students read their favourite sentence aloud.
sections.homework: Draw your family and write one sentence about them using the formula.
